name: The Akita Bank, Ltd.
summary: The Akita Bank, Ltd. provides banking and other financial services in Japan. It offers current, ordinary, savings, time, foreign currency, and other deposits; installment savings and deposits at notice; investment trust; and government bonds. The company also provides education, private and eco car, child rearing household support, renovation and vacant house demolition, migration and settlement support, doctor support, and mortgage loans; life insurance; trust and inheritance related products, such as will substitute, testamentary trust, estate settlement, and civil trust consulting services; and guardianship system supported deposits, as well as business support services.
